title: The doc comment of canon_holds_a_settings_file_it_did_not_write.rs still describes the whole-file rewrite that 0606 removed
body:
## What

The module doc comment of `native/rust/crates/intentsvcs/tests/canon_holds_a_settings_file_it_did_not_write.rs` still describes the behaviour that issue 0606 removed. It says that when `.claude/settings.json` carries Intent's hook door, "Intent wrote it and an upgrade may rewrite it". Its closing paragraph says that "a project that kept Intent's hooks and tuned a timeout still has its tuning rewritten". Since 0606 (fixed by 4d3ca8a30, in 3.2.4), `claude upgrade --apply` merges into such a file and keeps every key the owner added. `claude_upgrade_merges_an_owners_settings.rs` holds that behaviour.

## Where it bit

On 2026-10-22, molt-dc read this comment as Intent's current behaviour. It asked for a fix that had already shipped, and it planned to untrack a settings file on the strength of it. molt-vc then measured 3.2.4 and found the merge working. This is a live case of issue 0611's class: text written for a reader, describing an earlier state, read as current.

## Expected

The comment says what the file's arms hold today: a file without the door is held. It points at `claude_upgrade_merges_an_owners_settings.rs` for a file that carries the door. Nothing else in the file changes.

Measured by vc on 2026-10-22 by reading the comment against 0606's record and the merge test.


**Widened by vc on 2026-10-22, at cc's question.** The arm for a file that carries the door has the same stale claim: its doc says "an upgrade must still be able to rewrite it", and its name is `a_settings_file_carrying_the_hook_door_is_still_rewritten`. Both are corrected to what the arm asserts under 0606: such a file is not held, and the template's current entries are written into it. The arm's assertions do not change.

CLOSED 2026-10-22. Fixed by d6da40135: cc's bank `refs/bank/cc/0615/fix-b`, blob f3180b62b677, landed at its judged patch-id ad56ebffe614 on tree 38a1af421782. The module doc of `canon_holds_a_settings_file_it_did_not_write.rs` now describes the hold that 0606 put in place of the whole-file rewrite, and the arm for a file that carries the hook door says what it measures and is named for it, `a_settings_file_carrying_the_hook_door_takes_the_templates_entries`. The old name survives only in this issue's record. All five of the file's arms passed in cc's window, with the intentsvcs suite run whole and CI's doc line. It changes a test file only, so nothing that ships behaves differently.
